text:
Was it possible I did not know you were
near me, lost among the glances?

My eyes ached from waiting.
You passed by.

If only, appearing then,
you had revealed to me
the true country where you lived!

But you passed by
like a destroyed god.

Alone afterward, out of the darkness
came your gaze.

translation.title: Was It Possible I Did Not Know You Were There?
